entities.summary: Hans Krister Wickman was a Swedish politician. A member of the Social Democratic Party, he served as minister for foreign affairs from 1971 to 1973, and before that as minister of industry from 1969 to 1971. After his ministerial career, he was governor of Sveriges Riksbank from 1973 to 1976.
